summary: Round 3 re-check of the Evaluación Oftalmológica save reliability work. Backend: test_evaluacion_guardado_confiable.py ran 9 passed, 2 skipped (the legacy skips are expected). Frontend: (1) CRITICAL offline-queue overwrite, reproduced with the exact round-2 steps on an EXISTING evaluation: FIXED. 500 on PATCH led to 'Guardado offline' with the queue holding 'TEST_R3 OLD FAIL'. After unrouting, typing ' NEW' reached 'Guardado a las' and the queue was immediately null. After 36s the queue was still null and the server held 'TEST_R3 OLD FAIL NEW'; no stale PATCH was sent. The same fix also works for the manual 'Guardar' button on an existing evaluation and for the autosave POST (create) path. (2) Header fallback: FIXED. A legacy record for today was inserted in Mongo with paciente_nombre='' for Paciente106. Opening it by selecting the patient in the search box, or via ?paciente_id, shows 'Paciente106 Demo U5 / EXP-202610-0237 | 71 años | Femenino' and the search input is filled. NEW REMAINING DATA BUG (same family as the critical one): on a NEW evaluation, the autosave POST fails until 'Guardado offline'; then the doctor clicks the manual 'Guardar'. The stale queue entry is NOT cleared, and ~30s later syncPendingData POSTs it, creating a DUPLICATE evaluation for the same patient and day that holds the OLD text. Regression smoke tests all pass: normal patient selection header; floating indicator visible at every scroll position; 'Sin cambios' when idle; 422 shows 'Sin guardar — revisa los datos ingresados'; draft recovery dialog -> Recuperar -> 'Guardado a las', with the server holding the draft text; opening an evaluation from Historial loads all its data.

integration_issues.flow: NEW evaluation: autosave POST 5xx -> 'Guardado offline' (queue entry data.id=null) -> backend recovers -> user clicks manual 'Guardar' -> 30s sync
integration_issues.issue: Duplicate evaluation with stale data, reproduced on Paciente108. Server ends with 2 evaluations for 2026-11-11: 'PterigionTEST_R3_MANUAL OLD' (from the stale queue sync) and 'PterigionTEST_R3_MANUAL OLD NEW' (from the manual save). The UI shows 'Guardado a las' the whole time. RCA: guardarEvaluacion() calls limpiarColaOfflinePara(evaluacionId, ...) where evaluacionId is the NEW id returned by the POST. The matcher only falls back to the paciente_id match when evalId is falsy (`!evalId && !item.data?.id && item.data?.paciente_id === pacienteId`), so the 'create' entry (data.id null) is never matched. The syncPendingData safeguard also requires item.data.id, so it does not catch this either. POST /api/evaluaciones has no one-per-day dedupe, so a duplicate gets created. Fix: in limpiarColaOfflinePara, also match entries with `!item.data?.id && item.data?.paciente_id === pacienteId` even when evalId is set, OR pass the pre-save id (evaluacionActual?.id, which is null here) as well as the new id. Optionally, in syncPendingData, skip create entries for the current paciente when evaluacionActual has a real id and lastSavedRef >= item.timestamp. The autosave create path works because evaluacionActual?.id in its closure is still null.

issues: The warning toast 'No se pudo conectar con el servidor...' (id autosave-offline) stays on screen after the next save succeeds ('Guardado a las'), which is contradictory. Consider toast.dismiss('autosave-offline') on success.
The search input is empty and shrinks to an icon, and the patient name box wraps onto 4 lines (cosmetic, already seen in round 2).

action_items: HIGH: limpiarColaOfflinePara must also clear the paciente 'create' queue entry (data.id null) when the manual guardarEvaluacion() POST creates the evaluation. Right now the 30s sync re-POSTs the stale snapshot and creates a duplicate evaluation holding old data.
LOW: dismiss the 'autosave-offline' warning toast once a save is confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: limpiarColaOfflinePara matching is asymmetric: it only matches by paciente when evalId is null. Callers that pass a freshly created id (guardarEvaluacion) miss the create entry.

Not exercised: true browser-offline mode (navigator.onLine=false) sets evaluacionActual.id='offline_xxx' while the first queued entry has data.id=null. After reconnecting, autosave POSTs and calls limpiarColaOfflinePara('offline_xxx'), which also would not match a data.id=null entry. Likely the same duplicate risk; worth covering with the same fix.

Opening ?paciente_id for a patient with no evaluation today but with a prefilled cita motivo triggers an automatic POST right away (status 'Cambios sin guardar' with no user input), creating an evaluation just by viewing the patient. This was already the behavior; flagging for awareness.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (both target fixes verified; 1 remaining duplicate-on-manual-save-of-new-eval path)
